title: ReqPub acceptance receipt
description: The sealed record of one signature on one baseline. The seal is an Ed25519 signature over the SHA-256 of this object's canonical JSON per docs/VERIFY.md section 9; the .tsr files are RFC 3161 timestamps over that hash. No token and no email address appears; signer identity is name, role, and email domain. Additive-only within formatVersion 1.

sealedAt.description: ISO 8601 moment the seal was produced.

nameSha256.description: SHA-256 of the project name at seal time; the name itself does not ride in the receipt.

docFingerprint.description: The fingerprint captured at send. Empty only on the named legacy path.

recomputedFingerprint.description: Recomputed from the stored snapshot at seal time; divergence from a captured value aborts the seal.

fingerprintNote.description: Present only when the captured fingerprint was absent; names the legacy path.

headSeq.description: The project chain head at seal time, or null with a reason.

reason.description: Present only when the chain was unavailable at seal time.

kid.description: The signing key id; its public key is published in reqpub-keys.json.

practice.description: Present only on a practice record: a rehearsal, never evidence. Absent means evidence. Additive in formatVersion 1; every artifact produced before v2.55 is byte-unchanged.
